items.prompt: This laptop is ___ than the one I bought last year.

explanation.en: Cheap is short, so the comparative is cheaper.

optionNotes.en: Short adjectives do not take more.
The superlative does not combine with than.

items.prompt: Swimming is ___ for your back than running.

explanation.en: The comparative of good is better.

optionNotes.en: Good has an irregular comparative, not more good.
The superlative does not combine with than.

items.prompt: A: Is the new tram line quieter? B: Yes, it isn't as crowded ___ the old one.

explanation.en: The structure is not as … as.
explanation.es: Not as … as, no «not as … than».

optionNotes.en: Than follows a comparative, not as + adjective.
That is not used in comparisons.

items.prompt: Of the three candidates, Priya was ___ experienced.

explanation.en: With of the three we need a superlative: the least.

optionNotes.en: Less is a comparative for two things.
Correct: superlative for a group of three.
The less would need a second part, as in the less … the more.

items.prompt: Flats in the centre are ___ more expensive than they were five years ago.

explanation.en: Much, not very, can modify a comparative.
explanation.es: Very no se usa con comparativos: much more.

optionNotes.en: Most does not modify a comparative.
